description: Baseline interview data from the Ashgrove Community Health Survey (ACH): the Ashgrove Regional Health Unit ran the baseline interviews in 2022 and 2023, and the study's documents label the data synthetic. This package describes the 2024 data release (release 2 of the baseline data dictionary): one record per participant, recruited at three sites (Northgate, Riverside and Hillcrest), with age and sex, smoking history, women's reproductive health, body mass index measured at a clinic visit, and diabetes history. It follows the data dictionary and the baseline interview questionnaire, corrected by the data steward where the 2024 cleaning changed the data; for example, participant IDs carry a hyphen after the prefix and cigarettes per day is capped at 60. A smaller extract is sent to collaborators who only need demographics and smoking; it omits the other variables, so checking an extract against these schemas reports them as missing. Exports may also carry a "canary" quality-control column, which is not study data.
